relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggested that HucMSC-EX treatment can inhibit SCI-induced astrocyte activation, CSPG production, and glial scar formation around the lesion site.

key_findings: Exosome-loaded Gelfoam improved locomotor function, gait, nerve regeneration, remyelination and synapse formation after rat SCI.
Treatment reduced SCI-induced pain behaviors and levels of BDNF, TRPV1 and Cav3.2.
